mycv.mock_summary_desc: CV is formatted in standard structure. Technical skills are presented coherently, matching the requirements of Frontend Developer position. Projects are detailed, but quantitative metrics should be added (e.g., increased performance by 20%, reduced page load time...) to highlight your impact.

mycv.mock_improvement_2_desc: Projects should have Github links or live demos for recruiters to inspect real source code.
